title: Sport Sort Puzzle
desc: Sport Sort Puzzle is a sports-ball sorting game with football, basketball, tennis, golf, baseball, volleyball, and more. Move balls between bottles until every bottle contains one matching type.
howto: Tap a bottle to pick up the top ball.
Tap another bottle to place it on a matching ball or empty space.
Sort each bottle so it contains one ball type.
Use hints and undo when the board gets crowded.
tips: Keep at least one empty bottle available as a buffer.
Move rare ball types together early.
Do not bury a nearly complete bottle under the wrong ball.
Undo is most useful before a chain of forced moves.
